mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.train_id, s.stop_order, s.station_id, st.station_name, s.arrival_time, s.departure_time, s.day_offset, s.mileage, s.is_start, s.is_end FROM train_stop s LEFT JOIN station st ON st.id = s.station_id WHERE s.train_id = #{trainId} ORDER BY s.stop_order
mapper.insert:
